title: Define bootstrap ISO contract and boot stages
description: Document and validate the initrd→stage-2 contract: GPG/YubiKey unlock, SOPS material availability, SSH startup, Tailscale startup, runtime identity, and cleanup. Identify which current ISO modules remain and which are rescue-only.

title: Implement unique runtime rescue hostname
description: Add a deterministic runtime identifier from DMI UUID, machine-id, or MAC fallback; derive a collision-resistant rescue hostname and use it for Tailscale without baking per-host identity into the ISO.

title: Harden ephemeral Tailscale authentication flow
description: Move decrypted Tailscale auth material to /run, gate decryption behind the YubiKey/GPG flow, use restricted rescue tags, start Tailscale after prerequisites, and remove plaintext auth material after successful authentication.

title: Add disko and nixos-facter-backed install target
description: Add a real target host configuration with disko layout and committed nixos-facter report; remove placeholder filesystem assumptions and changeme credentials from nanoserver or replace it with an explicit install target.

title: Integrate rescue ISO installation workflow
description: Define the exact operator workflow for connecting to the already-booted rescue ISO over Tailscale/SSH and installing the final flake with nixos-anywhere/disko without an unnecessary second bootstrap transition.

title: Test rescue ISO in QEMU and on multiple simultaneous boots
description: Build and boot the ISO in QEMU, exercise YubiKey present/absent and auth failure paths, verify unique Tailscale hostnames across concurrent boots, validate secret cleanup, and test the destructive install path only against disposable disks.

title: gatewatch: constitution changed without explicit human sign-off
description: Evidence: commit 90085ea11599292ef86d5eb66abf84eb623b0b2e changed docs/CONSTITUTION.md (new file, lines 1-142) and was committed directly as 'chore(governance): standardize CONSTITUTION.md and automated workflows'. Article IX requires any change to docs/CONSTITUTION.md to receive explicit human review and forbids it from riding an auto-merged PR. The commit history and available seed tracker contain no explicit human sign-off for this change. Article VIII requires this SHA and path evidence.

title: gatewatch: audit triggers changed without explicit human sign-off
description: Evidence: commit 37fb42ad1de9044ee95966189ac04f7269e5b923 changed .warren/triggers.yaml (added gatewatch-patrol, ratchetwatch-patrol, tastewatch-sample and other trigger entries, lines 1-47) in 'chore(warren): configure triggers, feature loops, and update agentImage...'. Article IX requires changes to .warren/triggers.yaml audit entries to receive explicit human review and forbids them from riding an auto-merged PR. The commit history and available seed tracker contain no explicit human sign-off for this change. Article VIII requires this SHA and path evidence.
